title: Word Legion: Clash Royale, but every word you can spell is a card
author: Dangerous_Fig9791
selftext:
What if Clash Royale had an infinite deck?   
  
That's the idea behind Word Legion: instead of picking your troops, you spell them!   
Letters drop onto your rack, you make a word, and it becomes a unit whose abilities come from what the word means, so a SNAKE poisons, a GHOST turns invisible and a DRAGON flies over everything and sets it on fire. Longer and rarer words hit harder, and every word you play ends up in your collection, where you can go and see them all wandering around a little farm.   
  
I built it on my own, using some old-school language processing to work out what each word should do.   
  
You can play it right now in your browser for free: [https://wordlegion.bonnaf.com/en/?src=reddit-webgames](https://wordlegion.bonnaf.com/en/?src=reddit-webgames)
